description: Labelled ground-truth corpus for PER-05/06/07/08 — perimeter-access-audit's second half, added after PER-01/02/03/04 were frozen. Kept separate from cases.json (PER-01/02/04) rather than merged into it, since that corpus's fixtures were never designed to also carry llms-full.txt/sitemap.xml/.md inputs.
